name: threejs-skills
title_zh: 不写一行渲染代码，Three.js 场景从口述到可交
tagline_zh: 写 3D 交互最烦相机、灯光、后期这些样板。这套包把十个高频场景直接拆成可调用模块，粘贴即跑，不用从零搭。
tagline_en: Tired of boilerplate camera, lights, and postprocessing? These 10 modules drop into any Three.js scene—paste and.
why_zh: 每个 skill 只做一件事，但内部把 renderer、composer、controls 的联动都。
why_en: Each skill does one thing, but wires renderer, composer, and controls together—saves you at least two hours of doc-diving per.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Three.js 官方示例风格的基础场景，不含 GLTF 加载、物理引擎或自定义 shader 调试。
limit_en: Covers only basic Three.js example-style scenes; no GLTF loading, physics, or custom shader debugging. Modules don't share state—complex projects.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Describe a 3D scene, get a working Three.js sketch
